title: Starter gateway visual flowcards and modular hero for quickstart landing
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a new modular hero and entry flowcard system for the Quickstart landing page that communicates onboarding paths for different user profiles (Hackers, PMs, Platform Engineers). Deliverables: hero art variations (static / animated / interactive microstates), a set of 4 flowcards with progressive disclosure states, responsive breakpoints, updated product screenshots with annotated overlays, and a small component kit for engineering handoff. The system should support: A/B testing two hero variants, automatic screenshot swapping by region, and screenshots that surface token-level cost & latency callouts per route.
acceptance_criteria: Three hero variants delivered (Static illustration, Micro-interaction hero, and Modular cards composition) with Figma frames for desktop/tablet/mobile
Four flowcards with 3 progressive states each (teaser, expand, deep-link) exported as production PNGs and SVGs
Annotated product screenshots reflecting new Quickstart steps with callouts for Console dashboards and sample SDK snippet
Accessible color contrast verified (AA for body text, 4.5:1) and keyboard focus states documented
Design tokens and spacing system documented and a dev-ready handoff (component props, export tokens) uploaded to the repo
tasks: Kickoff with PM and Research to align on three user personas and success metrics
Create moodboard and 6 concept explorations for hero composition
Iterate two chosen concepts into hi-fi Figma flows and micro-interaction specs
Produce annotated product screenshots with synthetic test data and masked PII
Export assets and tidy component token list for engineering (SVGs, sprites, animated Lottie where applicable)
Write handoff doc + acceptance checklist and run design review with Eng on 2026-03-08
